title: SLIC: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning Small LMs for Multi-Turn Analog Circuit Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.13452v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Analog integrated circuit (IC) design is a multi-turn, simulator-grounded engineering task that demands iterative reasoning over coupled performance tradeoffs, yet proprietary process design kits (PDKs) make hosted large language model workflows difficult to deploy in practical design settings. We present SLIC (Small LM Iterating on Circuits), a reinforcement fine-tuning framework that trains a 4B-scale, locally deployable language model for closed-loop analog circuit optimization. SLIC pairs structured circuit representations with discretized relative-update actions, domain- and success-gated multiobjective rewards, and Reward-Guided Rollout Steering (RGRS), which turns per-step simulator feedback into signals for both policy learning and online rollout construction in this sparse, highly constrained domain. We further release an open, goal-conditioned benchmark of 41 amplifier topologies with standardized protocols for in-distribution

translated_title: SLIC：通过强化微调小语言模型实现多轮模拟电路优化
translated_abstract: 模拟集成电路（IC）设计是一项多轮、以仿真器为基础的工程任务，需要对相互耦合的性能权衡进行迭代推理，然而专有的工艺设计套件（PDK）使得托管式大型语言模型工作流难以在实际设计环境中部署。我们提出了SLIC（Small LM Iterating on Circuits，小语言模型电路迭代），这是一个强化微调框架，用于训练一个40亿参数规模、可本地部署的语言模型，以实现闭环模拟电路优化。SLIC将结构化电路表示与离散化的相对更新动作相结合，采用领域门控和成功门控的多目标奖励，并引入奖励引导的滚动规划技术（Reward-Guided Rollout Steering，RGRS），将每一步的仿真器反馈转化为策略学习和在线滚动构建的信号，从而应对这一稀疏且高度受限的领域。我们进一步发布了一个开放的、目标条件化的基准测试集，包含41种放大器拓扑结构，并为分布内场景提供了标准化协议。
tldr: 本文提出SLIC强化微调框架，将40亿参数的本地部署小语言模型训练用于闭环多轮模拟电路优化，其核心创新在于结合结构化电路表示、门控多目标奖励和奖励引导滚动规划（RGRS），并发布了包含41种放大器拓扑的开放基准测试集。
en_tdlr: SLIC is a reinforcement fine-tuning framework that trains a 4B-scale, locally deployable language model for closed-loop multi-turn analog circuit optimization, featuring structured circuit representations, gated multiobjective rewards, and Reward-Guided Rollout Steering (RGRS), along with an open benchmark of 41 amplifier topologies.
